response.justification: While Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack engineering skills and recent engagement with AI-agent infrastructure, this CTO role requires proven executive leadership at scale (managing 10-30+ teams) in regulated fintech with production multi-agent AI shipping experience. The resume shows deep technical capabilities but critically lacks executive track record, fintech domain expertise, regulated-environment operations, and demonstrated ability to build and lead large engineering organizations.
strengths: 20 years of progressive full-stack engineering across web, backend, and infrastructure with documented ability to ship complex systems
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP at re:cinq, demonstrating recent engagement with core domain requirements
Proven expertise building high-performance distributed systems handling millions of requests/sec with microservices and container orchestration
concerns: No demonstrated executive or CTO-level team leadership; all roles are individual-contributor or senior-engineer positions without evidence of scaling to 10-30+ people
Only ~1.3 years fintech experience with no evidence of deep credit systems, compliance, or regulated-environment expertise required for this role
Limited production track record shipping complex multi-agent AI systems; recent AI work at re:cinq is positive but insufficient given other critical gaps
